notes.title: Last Hope Public Roadmap - See our plans for Last Hope.
notes.content:
[h1]Last Hope Public Roadmap[/h1]
Welcome to the Last Hope Public Roadmap! We're thrilled to share our journey toward making Last Hope the ultimate 5v5 PvP FPS experience. Your feedback and support mean the world to us. Please note that timelines are dynamic and subject to change as we refine and enhance the game.
[h2]Quarter 1, 2024: Alpha Testing and Core Gameplay[/h2][list]    [*][b]January 4th - February 1st:[/b] Alpha Playtest on Steam        [list]            [*]Dive into the intense 5v5 action and provide essential feedback on core gameplay mechanics.[/*]            [*]Evaluate map layouts and identify potential balance adjustments.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Quarter 2, 2024: Tactical Gameplay Refinement[/h2][list]    [*][b]March - April:[/b] Operator Abilities Overhaul        [list]            [*]Refine and balance unique operator abilities based on Alpha Playtest feedback.[/*]            [*]Introduce new tactical gadgets and strategies.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]May - June:[/b] Map Overhaul and Expansion        [list]            [*]Revise existing maps based on player feedback and improve navigation.[/*]            [*]Introduce a new map to diversify tactical options.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Quarter 3, 2024: Immersive Experience Enhancement[/h2][list]    [*][b]July:[/b] Visual and Audio Atmosphere Upgrade        [list]            [*]Enhance graphics for better clarity and visual appeal.[/*]            [*]Introduce immersive audio enhancements for heightened situational awareness.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]August:[/b] Weapon and Equipment Customization        [list]            [*]Introduce a robust weapon customization system.[/*]            [*]Add new weapons and equipment options to diversify player loadouts.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Quarter 4, 2024: Competitive Features and Pre-Launch Prep[/h2][list]    [*][b]September - October:[/b] Ranked Mode Beta        [list]            [*]Implement and test the competitive ranked mode.[/*]            [*]Gather feedback on matchmaking, ranking systems, and competitive balance.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]November:[/b] eSports Integration and Feature Freeze        [list]            [*]Lay the groundwork for eSports integration and partnerships.[/*]            [*]Complete feature implementation and shift focus to polishing and optimizing for launch.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Beyond 2024: Post-Launch Support and Expansions[/h2][list]    [*][b]Ongoing:[/b] Post-Launch Tournaments and Balance Updates        [list]            [*]Host regular tournaments and events to keep the competitive scene vibrant.[/*]            [*]Continuously update and balance the game based on community feedback.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Exploration:[/b] Seasonal Expansions and Community-Driven Content        [list]            [*]Introduce seasonal expansions with new maps, operators, and game modes.[/*]            [*]Encourage community involvement in map design and content creation.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
